The firm helps blockchain companies harden smart contracts, gain a clearer understanding of contract storage, and identify a wide range of potential vulnerabilities. It also develops tools for Web3 developers, including a suite of open source security tools such as Slither, Manticore, and Echidna. Through its combination of auditing expertise and security tooling, Trail of Bits supports the secure development of Web3 applications.

content.short: Transak is a global fiat on/off ramp and onboarding toolkit.
content.description: Transak provides web3 payments infrastructure that makes onboarding and offboarding web3 users intuitive within any experience. Any web3 application can integrate Transak's suite of products On-Ramp, Off-Ramp, NFT Checkout, Transak One, Corporate On/Off-Ramp, and more to onboard new users from 160+ countries with a minimal learning curve. The platform delivers a cohesive, ready-to-implement payment flow that reduces complexity for developers and helps projects reach diverse audiences without heavy custom work.

content.short: Transit Swap is a multichain swap and bridge aggregator that helps users move assets across TON and other networks.
content.description: Transit Swap is a cross-chain swap and decentralized exchange platform that enables real-time, trustless asset swaps across multiple networks. It integrates liquidity from a wide set of DEXs and aggregates quotes from several sources, helping users find favorable rates without leaving the platform. The Transit Swap API returns up-to-date price quotes for token swaps on all supported networks. Liquidity is sourced from top DEXs such as Uniswap, Sushi, PancakeSwap, and more across Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, and beyond.
